title: Step 3 - Configuring Apriori Function: Support, Confidence, and Lift in Python

cues.en: -: All right, my friends are you ready to train your apriori model on the whole data set?

cues.zh: 這就是我的意思。

cues.zh: 大部分工作已完成，現在只要從第一個儲存格安裝的 apyori 套件，呼叫 apriori 函式，

cues.en: with some relevant values of the parameters.
cues.zh: 並為參數選擇適當的值。

cues.en: And that's will be most of the reflection we'll have when building and training this apriori model.
cues.zh: 建立與訓練 Apriori 模型時，主要要思考的就是這件事。

cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.zh: 匯入的函式庫只有 NumPy、Matplotlib 和 pandas，所以現在確實要匯入 apriori 函式，

cues.zh: 它屬於一開始安裝的 apyori 套件。

cues.zh: 所以先從 apyori 套件開始。

cues.en: There you go, from which we import that apriori function.
cues.zh: 從中匯入 apriori 函式。

cues.en: All right, there we go again, apriori.
cues.zh: 就是 apriori。

cues.en: And now, now we can call that function.
cues.zh: 現在可以呼叫這個函式了。

cues.en: All right, so first thing to understand is that this function will actually return the rules.
cues.zh: 首先要了解，這個函式其實會傳回規則。

cues.en: You know, not only will train a apriori model on the data set, but also at the same time this function will indeed train this a apriori model and in the end, return the final rules, you know
cues.zh: 不只是訓練資料集上的 Apriori 模型，還會同時完成模型訓練，最後傳回最終規則，

cues.en: with the different supports, confidences and lifts.
cues.zh: 附上各自的支持度、信賴度和提升度。

cues.en: And therefore, since we're now ready to call this function and since this function returns the rules well let's create a new variable here which we're simply going to call rules.
cues.zh: 所以既然準備好呼叫函式，而且會傳回規則，就在這裡建立新變數，直接叫 rules。

cues.en: All right and that will be the output of that function.
cues.zh: 它會是這個函式的輸出。

cues.en: And speaking of that function, well let's call it right now apriori.
cues.zh: 說到函式，現在呼叫 apriori。

cues.en: That's the function.
cues.zh: 這就是函式。

cues.en: Therefore I'm adding some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 所以加上一對括號。

cues.en: And now there we go.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: Let's see what parameters we have to input.
cues.zh: 看看要輸入哪些參數。

cues.en: All right, so this function takes as input some very intuitive arguments.
cues.zh: 這個函式接受一些很直覺的引數。

cues.en: We could actually, you know, almost guess all of them.
cues.zh: 幾乎全部都能猜到。

cues.en: The first one is of course, well the dataset, you know the dataset on which you're gonna train your apriori model.
cues.zh: 第一個當然是資料集，也就是要用來訓練 Apriori 模型的資料集。

cues.en: And the name for that parameter is transactions actually.
cues.zh: 這個參數的名稱其實是 transactions。

cues.en: You know, because the apriori model is mostly used to compute some correlations and association rules among transactions.
cues.zh: 因為 Apriori 模型主要用來計算交易間的相關性與關聯規則。

cues.en: So that's actually the name of the parameter.
cues.zh: 所以參數就叫這個名字。

cues.en: And of course the value for that parameter must be, well, that same transactions list which we created in the right format
cues.zh: 參數值當然必須是相同的 transactions 串列，我們在這堂之前，

cues.en: right before the tutorial in the data preprocessing phase.
cues.zh: 資料前處理階段已經用正確格式建立它。

cues.en: Okay, so this is the name of the parameter and this is the name of our transactions list which is the value of indeed that parameter.
cues.zh: 這是參數名稱，這是交易串列的名稱，也就是參數的值。

cues.en: Okay, good, so that's for the first argument.
cues.zh: 好，第一個引數就這樣。

cues.en: That was an obvious one.
cues.zh: 這很明顯。

cues.en: And now according to you, what would be the next argument?
cues.zh: 你覺得下一個引數是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the next argument has to do with the support.
cues.zh: 和支持度有關。

cues.en: Of course, it's not gonna be a simple support because we have a support for each rule but what we can set is actually a minimum support,
cues.zh: 當然不是單純的支持度，因為每條規則都有自己的支持度；可以設定的是最低支持度，

cues.en: you know in order not to compute all the rules, but only the rules that have at least some certain relevance.
cues.zh: 讓我們不用計算所有規則，只計算至少有一定意義的規則。

cues.en: And therefore, we will set a minimum support value in order to take not all the rules but only the rules that have a support higher than this minimum support.
cues.zh: 因此設定最低支持度，只保留支持度高於這個下限的規則。

cues.en: All right, So let's first enter the name of the parameter here, which is min underscore support Right, and now according to you
cues.zh: 先輸入參數名稱 min_support。你覺得

cues.en: what should we choose as a minimum support here?
cues.zh: 這裡應該選多少作為最低支持度？

cues.en: Well, this has to do of course, with our situation, you know the problem itself and of course some common sense.
cues.zh: 這當然取決於情境、問題本身，以及一些常識。

cues.en: So let's recap.
cues.zh: 回顧一下。

cues.en: We have in total 7501 transactions that were recorded We have in total 7501 transactions that were recorded over one full week and among these 7501 transactions
cues.zh: 總共有 7,501 筆交易，是在完整一週內記錄的；這 7,501 筆交易中，

cues.en: we want to get the most relevant rules.
cues.zh: 想找出最有意義的規則。

cues.en: You know, the were,
cues.zh: 也就是，

cues.en: you know, the strongest rules of two elements, you know, with one element of the left hand side of the rule, you know one product and one element in the right hand side of the rule, which is another product.
cues.zh: 最強的兩元素規則，左側一個元素，也就是一項產品，右側另一個元素，也就是另一項產品。

cues.en: And we won't therefore these products to appear a minimum amount of time.
cues.zh: 所以希望這些產品至少出現一定次數。

cues.en: And that's exactly what the support is about.
cues.zh: 這正是支持度的意義。

cues.en: Remember the support of a couple of products.
cues.zh: 記得一對產品的支持度，

cues.en: A and B is the number of transactions containing these two products, A and B, divided by the total number of transactions.
cues.zh: 也就是 A、B 的支持度，是包含兩項產品的交易筆數，除以交易總筆數。

cues.en: So we need to see here, you know, for a couple of products A and B, how many times per week we need to have at least these two products in the transactions?
cues.zh: 所以要想，對一對產品 A、B，每週至少要在交易中出現幾次？

cues.en: Well, you know, let's use some common sense.
cues.zh: 運用一些常識。

cues.en: Let's say that each day we would like to consider the products that appear in at least three transactions in the day, all right?
cues.zh: 假設只想考慮每天至少出現在三筆交易中的產品，好嗎？

cues.en: Three transactions in a day, because all the products that appear in only one transaction or two transactions you know, are actually not frequent.
cues.zh: 一天三筆，因為只出現在一筆或兩筆交易中的產品，其實不算常見。

cues.en: And we would not build some strong rules out of these products.
cues.zh: 也無法從這些產品建立強規則。

cues.en: So our common sense here is to only consider the products that appear at least three times a day.
cues.zh: 所以這裡的常識判斷，是只考慮每天至少出現三次的產品。

cues.en: And therefore, since the 7501 transactions were recorded during the full week, well, we need to multiply this number of three transactions per day by seven
cues.zh: 既然 7,501 筆交易是整週記錄的，就要把每天三筆乘以七，

cues.en: in order to get you know, that minimum number of times we wanna see these products in the transactions per week.
cues.zh: 得到希望這些產品每週至少在交易中出現的次數。

cues.en: And therefore that number of times is three times seven equals 21.
cues.zh: 所以是 3 乘以 7，等於 21。

cues.en: And since the support is the number of times the products appear in the transactions divided by the total number of transactions well the minimum support,
cues.zh: 支持度是產品出現在交易中的次數除以交易總數，因此最低支持度，

cues.en: considering that we want to see minimum three times per day the products must be three times seven divided by 7501.
cues.zh: 若要求每天至少出現三次，就是 3 乘以 7，再除以 7,501。

cues.en: the products must be three times seven divided by 7501.
cues.zh: 也就是 3 乘以 7，除以 7,501。

cues.en: All right, so that's purely based on common sense.
cues.zh: 這完全是基於常識判斷。

cues.en: You could choose another minimum support, but there you go, that's a minimum support that goes well with our scenario, you know, with our business case study.
cues.zh: 可以選其他最低支持度，但這個值符合我們的情境與商業案例。

cues.en: And therefore, what I'm simply going to do now is just open a new tab here to quickly compute, well, three as in minimum, three times we wanna see the products appear
cues.zh: 現在只要開新分頁，快速計算 3，代表每天希望產品至少出現

cues.en: in the transactions per day, then times seven because the 7,501 transactions are recorded over a week.
cues.zh: 三次，再乘以 7，因為這 7,501 筆交易是一週的紀錄。

cues.en: And therefore when calculating the support and dividing by the total number of transactions numerator and the denominator must be in the same unit of time, which is one week
cues.zh: 計算支持度並除以交易總數時，分子與分母必須是相同時間單位，也就是一週，

cues.en: and then divided by 7501 total transactions and then divided by 7501 total transactions Let's just press enter, we'll get the result which is 0.0027,
cues.zh: 再除以 7,501 筆交易。按 Enter，得到 0.0027，

cues.en: and we can round that up to 0.003.
cues.zh: 可以往上取成 0.003。

cues.en: And oh 0.003 will be exactly our minimum support.
cues.zh: 0.003 正是我們的最低支持度。

cues.en: So I'm gonna close this and I'm gonna enter here 0.003, perfect.
cues.zh: 關掉這裡，輸入 0.003，很好。

cues.en: So that's for our minimum support.
cues.zh: 這就是最低支持度。

cues.en: Now, the next argument, what do you think it's going to be?
cues.zh: 下一個引數，你覺得是什麼？

cues.en: Well, you probably guess that this time we're gonna choose a minimum confidence Right, a minimum confidence.
cues.zh: 你可能猜到了，這次要選最低信賴度。

cues.en: All right, so this time what should we set as the minimum confidence?
cues.zh: 最低信賴度該設多少？

cues.en: Should we use, again, common sense or should we try some different values?
cues.zh: 再次運用常識，還是試不同的值？

cues.en: Well, this time we won't do the same kind of calculation as we did for the support.
cues.zh: 這次不會像支持度一樣計算。

cues.en: This time, I'm rather gonna give you some rule of thumps, you know which you can try when doing association rule learning.
cues.zh: 這次會給你一些做關聯規則學習時，可以嘗試的經驗法則。

cues.en: So I know from the other packages, you know the one from R because there is actually a great function in R to do association rule learning and it has indeed a default value
cues.zh: 我知道其他套件，例如 R 裡其實有個很棒的關聯規則學習函式，而它有一個

cues.en: for the minimum confidence, which is 0.8.
cues.zh: 最低信賴度的預設值，0.8。

cues.en: So what I actually did, you know for this problem is to start first with 0.8 but this was way too high because 0.8 would require the rule to be correct 80% of the time,
cues.zh: 所以這個問題我先從 0.8 開始，但太高，因為 0.8 要求規則在 80% 的情況成立，

cues.en: and therefore I ended up with actually no rule.
cues.zh: 結果一條規則都沒有。

cues.en: So I had to reduce the confidence, so I divided it by two so that I can try minimum confidence of 0.4 but still I got very few rules
cues.zh: 所以必須降低信賴度，先除以二，試 0.4，但仍然只有很少規則，

cues.en: and so I divided it by two again.
cues.zh: 於是再除以二。

cues.en: And just with 0.2, I actually got some great rules you know, not too much, not too few, but a dozen of them.
cues.zh: 到了 0.2，終於得到一些很好的規則，不多不少，大概十幾條。

cues.en: So that was a good choice and that's how I chose this minimum confidence.
cues.zh: 所以這是個好選擇，我就是這樣選最低信賴度。

cues.en: Therefore, here for this minimum confidence we will set it equal to 0.2, okay?
cues.zh: 因此，最低信賴度設成 0.2，好嗎？

cues.en: Once again, no rule of thumbs.
cues.zh: 再說一次，沒有固定法則。

cues.en: You can try different values depending on your business requirements.
cues.zh: 可以根據業務需求嘗試不同的值。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then next parameter, I'm sure you guessed it as well that is this time the minimum lift.
cues.zh: 下一個參數，相信你也猜到了，這次是最低提升度。

cues.en: You know that other metric which measures the quality of a rule or the relevance of a rule.
cues.zh: 也就是另一個衡量規則品質或相關程度的指標。

cues.en: And so now according to you what would be a good minimum lift?
cues.zh: 你覺得好的最低提升度是多少？

cues.en: Well, that kind of decision to make, you know you get them with experience.
cues.zh: 這類決策會隨著經驗累積而掌握。

cues.en: You will see through the many association rule learning models that you're gonna build on your data sets that generally a good lift is at least three,
cues.zh: 隨著你在資料集上建立許多關聯規則學習模型，會發現一般來說，好的提升度至少是 3，

cues.en: you know, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 even eight, nine, you know, these are good lifts.
But lift below three make the rules not that relevant.
cues.zh: 但低於 3 的提升度，會讓規則沒那麼有意義。

cues.en: And therefore, this is kind of a rule of thumbs that I'm giving you here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡給你的是一種經驗法則。

cues.en: It is not based on common sense, rather based on experience.
cues.zh: 不是基於常識，而是基於經驗。

cues.en: And therefore I recommend to choose a minimum lift of three.
cues.zh: 因此建議最低提升度選 3。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And with this minimum lift we will get good rules, you know, relevant rules.
cues.zh: 用這個最低提升度，就能得到好的、有意義的規則。

cues.en: Okay, so minimum lift equals three.
cues.zh: 好，min_lift 等於 3。

cues.en: And then we have two last arguments that are actually very very important.
cues.zh: 接著還有最後兩個很重要的引數。

cues.en: And in fact, compulsory for our business problem it has to do with the fact that, you know we want to identify the best deals of buy one product A
cues.zh: 對這個商業問題其實是必要的，因為我們要找出「買一項產品 A，

cues.en: and get another product B for free.
cues.zh: 免費送另一項產品 B」的最佳優惠。

cues.en: And therefore the rules we want to get in the end must have only two products, one product in the left hand side of the rule, and one product in the right hand side of the rule,
cues.zh: 因此，最終規則必須只有兩項產品，左側一項、右側一項，

cues.en: All right and therefore, to make sure we have this, you know one product A on the left and one product B on the right, well, we need to add two more arguments here which is first min length,
cues.zh: 好，要確保左側一個 A、右側一個 B，還要加兩個引數，首先是 min_length，

cues.en: Okay, and then max length, where of course min length is the minimum number of elements you want to have in your rule.
cues.zh: 再來是 max_length。min_length 當然是規則中最少的元素數量，

cues.en: You know, left to right and max length is the maximum number of elements you wanna have in your rule left to right.
cues.zh: 從左到右合計；max_length 則是規則中最多的元素數量。

cues.en: And therefore, here to make sure we only have two in our rule, you know, one on the left and one on the right.
cues.zh: 所以要確保規則只有兩項，左邊一項、右邊一項，

cues.en: Well, obviously we need to set min length to two and max length, same to two.
cues.zh: 顯然 min_length 和 max_length 都要設成 2。

cues.en: And that's only because in our business problem we want to find these best deals of buying one product A and get one product B for free.
cues.zh: 這只是因為這個商業問題，想找出「買一項產品 A，免費送一項產品 B」的最佳優惠。

cues.en: And therefore our rules must have exactly two elements.
cues.zh: 所以規則必須恰好有兩個元素。

cues.en: Then imagine you wanted to find the best deals of buy two products and get a third one for free.
cues.zh: 假設想找「買兩項產品，免費送第三項」的最佳優惠，

cues.en: Then you would set to three and max lengths to three.
cues.zh: 就把 min_length 和 max_length 都設成 3。

cues.en: And if you wanna be very, very flexible on your deals like you know, you could have deals with buy one product A and get one product B for free, or buy two products A and get one product B for free.
cues.zh: 如果想讓優惠很有彈性，例如可以買一項 A 送一項 B，也可以買兩項 A 送一項 B，

cues.en: Or you know, buy 10 products and get one for free one.
cues.zh: 或買十項送一項，

cues.en: In this case, you would set min lengths to two and then max lengths two 11.
cues.zh: 這時 min_length 設為 2，max_length 設為 11。

cues.en: Okay? So that really depends on your business requirements your business problem.
cues.zh: 好嗎？這真的取決於業務需求與商業問題。

cues.en: Here we just wanna find the best deals of two products by one product A get one product B for free, and that's it.
cues.zh: 這裡只想找出兩項產品的最佳優惠，買一項 A、免費送一項 B，就這樣。

cues.en: And that's why we set min length to two and max length to two, so that our rule can have only two products.
cues.zh: 所以 min_length 與 max_length 都設成 2，規則就只會有兩項產品。

cues.en: All right, and that's it.
cues.zh: 好，就是這樣。

cues.en: Well, you know, we're done with this apriori function which will return the rules respecting all these values we set for the parameters.
cues.zh: apriori 函式設定好了，它會傳回符合這些參數值的規則。

cues.en: A minimum support of 0.003 which means that the products in the rules appear at least oh 0.3% of the time.
cues.zh: 最低支持度 0.003，表示規則中的產品至少在 0.3% 的交易中出現。

cues.en: Then the minimum confidence, which means that for each product A in the left hand side of the rules well we will have product B in the right hand side of the rule at least 20% of the time.
cues.zh: 最低信賴度表示，對規則左側每項產品 A，至少 20% 的情況也會有右側產品 B。

cues.en: And then we have a minimum lift of three and we have only two products in our rules.
cues.zh: 接著最低提升度是 3，而且規則只有兩項產品。

cues.en: Thanks to this min length equals two and max length equals two.
cues.zh: 這要歸功於 min_length = 2 和 max_length = 2。

cues.zh: 輸出裡還不會顯示它們，但別擔心，這堂之後的最後部分會把它們顯示出來。
